tables.name: plain-rich
tables.sdl:
schema {
  query: Query
  mutation: Mutation
}

scalar Number

scalar Date

scalar JSON

scalar JSONObject

scalar Void

scalar Any

scalar File

enum Colour {
  RED
  GREEN
  BLUE
}

interface Node {
  id: ID!
}

interface Named {
  name: String!
}

type Leafs implements Node & Named {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  text: String
  count: Int
  ratio: Float
  flag: Boolean
  amount: Number
  when: Date
  payload: JSON
  bag: JSONObject
  nothing: Void
  anything: Any
  colour: Colour
  texts: [String!]
  matrix: [[Int!]!]
}

type Branch implements Node {
  id: ID!
  label: String!
  leafs: Leafs!
  children: [Branch!]!
  maybeChild: Branch
  peers: [Node!]
}

union Anything = Leafs | Branch

input Inner {
  flag: Boolean!
}

input Filter {
  required: String!
  optional: Int
  limit: Int = 10
  tags: [String!]
  colour: Colour
  nested: Inner
}

type Query {
  leafs: Leafs!
  branch: Branch
  node: Node
  nodes: [Node!]!
  anything: Anything
  search(filter: Filter, tag: String, count: Int, colour: Colour, ids: [ID!], when: Date): [Leafs!]
  strictSearch(filter: Filter!, tag: String!, count: Int!, colour: Colour!, ids: [ID!]!): [Leafs!]!
  valueLeaf: String
  undefinedLeaf: String
  nanLeaf: Number
  infinityLeaf: Number
  fnLeaf: String
  argLeaf(text: String!): String
  resolvedLeaf: String
  rejectedLeaf: String
  afterLeaf: String
  afterErrorLeaf: String
  throwLeaf: String
  serviceLeaf: String
  graphqlLeaf: String
  aggregateLeaf: String
  errorValueLeaf: String
}

type Mutation {
  touch(input: Filter!): Leafs!
  rename(id: ID!, name: String!): Branch
}
